evidence.detail: rs/cache/osrs/a is an enum with surviving exact constants MODELS, ANIMS, SOUNDS and MAPS, each paired with a numeric cache-store index and human label.
Its constructor derives an exact osrs_idx<id> path from the R66 Signlink cache-directory root, binding each enum value to one OSRS cache index directory.
rs/cache/osrs/b iterates these values, uses the enum path to locate asset-pack files, the label for diagnostics, and the numeric id to select one R64 CacheStoreSet Decompressor.

candidates.note: OsrsCacheIndex is the conservative semantic name for this OSRS asset-category/cache-index enum; it does not claim a verbatim original developer identifier.

evidence.detail: rs/cache/osrs/b iterates every OsrsCacheIndex, opens its pack directory, logs the exact surviving message 'Scanning assets in pack directory {} index (file count: {})', and considers .gz asset files.
For each numeric .gz file it reads the bytes, parses the filename-derived asset id and writes the payload into the R64 CacheStoreSet Decompressor selected by the enum cache index.
R24 OnDemandFetcher constructs this class after initializing main_file_osrs.dat/main_file_osrs.idx and invokes its pack operation when the OSRS asset-pack feature flag is enabled.
The class reports 'Packed new assets into {} index ({} files)' and 'Unable to locate index {}.', directly identifying its cache-packing responsibility.

candidates.note: OsrsAssetPacker is the conservative semantic name for this OSRS pack-directory scanner/cache writer; it does not claim a verbatim original developer identifier.
